question.problem: Find the greatest common divisor of $1\,248$ and $816.$
question.worked_solution:
We use the Euclidean algorithm, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}1\,248 & = & 816(1) & + & 432 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 816 & = & 432(1) & + & 384 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 432 & = & 384(1) & + & 48 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 384 & = & 48(8) & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The last positive remainder is $48.$ Therefore, we conclude that the greatest common divisor of $1\,248$ and $816$ is $48.$ Symbolically, we write

$$
\text{gcd}(1\,248,816)=48.
$$
